items.title: MinerU · MinerU 4.2.1
items.summary: ## 4.2.1 - **修复 Doclib 截断续读遗漏内容**。Markdown 文档或单页读取在 `context=0` 时，达到长度限制后通过 `next_request.locator` 与 `next_request.after` 继续读取当前页的剩余内容，读完后再建议下一页。CLI 续读标记和 SDK 文档同步更新。 - **完善托管解析服务的故障恢复**。连续启动或重启失败达到上限后停止自动重试，并清理残留进程。重新设置托管模式或档位、重启文档库服务后可再次尝试恢复。切换模式、档位及关闭服务时，完善旧进程和控制通道的回收。 - **修复 Windows 托管服务端口探测**。按照服务实际绑定行为检查端口，在非严格端口模式下跳过已占用或被系统保留的端口，减少探测成功后仍无法启动的问题。 - **改善文档库服务的优雅退出**。通过宿主停机

items.title: Benchmarking Multilingual Document Understanding in Vision-Language Models
items.summary: Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform strongly on multimodal tasks, Document Understanding (DU) among them, but the benchmarks that measure them mostly cover English documents and narrow problems. items.title: Word-Level Alignment of OCR and Ground Truth under Zoning and Reading-Order Errors
items.summary: OCR post-processing needs OCR text aligned word by word with its ground truth. Data sets rarely provide that mapping, and a monotone aligner can lose its place when zoning errors permute the reading order. items.summary: In Uzbek official and technical documents, a large share of OCR errors is caused not by poor image quality but by characters that are visually identical across the two alphabets in use. items.summary: Agricultural documents, such as prefectural technical reports and crop calendars, are critical knowledge resources. items.title: RankShift: Evaluating Ranking Instability Across Benchmark Dimensions in Document Parsing
